title: Figure 40: real acoustic pressure vs radial distance, 1000 Hz radiating sphere
description: ANSYS 12.1 line graph of steady-state real component of pressure (Pa) as a function of radial distance (m) for 1,000 Hz with 25 elements per wavelength in water. Damped oscillating curve comparing ANSYS result and theory for the uniformly radiating sphere, EPW=25. From the BAASS underwater acoustics validation.
